visual.general_description: Six color photographs (A to F) of eyes under blue light with green fluorescein-type staining, arranged as baseline, 1 week and 1 month pairs.
visual.detailed_description: The figure comes from two image files. The first file holds panel A alone. The second holds panels B to F placed on a white background in staggered positions: B at the upper left, E at the upper right, C at the middle left, F at the right, and D at the lower left. Each panel is a close-up of an eye under cobalt-blue illumination with green fluorescence along the lid margins, a white light reflex and eyelashes visible. Each panel letter is printed in black below its image. No arrows, scale bars, patient text or dates are visible.

panels.general_description: Color photograph of an eye under blue light with green fluorescence (panel A).
panels.detailed_description: Close-up photograph under cobalt-blue illumination of one eye, taller than wide. Green fluorescent bands run along the upper and lower lid margins. The corneal surface carries scattered fine green speckles, a small bright white reflex, and a darker bluish irregular area in the central and upper-right corneal region with a faint rounded outline. Eyelashes cross the top left and bottom of the image. The letter A is printed below the image at the lower left.
